bagPolicy.summary: Bags will be searched upon entry, and large or oversized bags/backpacks are not permitted. Express entry lanes are available for those without bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is limited metered street parking near the venue. Commercial lots are available on 5th and Bainbridge Streets, which accept cash only. ParkWhiz offers additional parking options.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Broadview Stage at SPAC's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Broadview Stage at SPAC varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Broadview Stage at SPAC, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Broadview Stage at SPAC's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The “Will Call” window is located off the Route 50 parking lot at the Main Box Office ONLY. Broadview Stage at SPAC suggest you arrive at Will Call 1-2 hours prior to the show to avoid long lines.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Broadview Stage at SPAC. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
